Синхронизация загружает следующие страни: Playlist sync loads all pages and reports YouTube Music errors. Firefox sign-in checks available sessions and saves a verified session. Позиция восстанавливается после готовнос: Playback position is restored after mpv is ready. Clear upcoming keeps the current track. Stop and clear stops audio and saves an empty queue. Tracks can be moved, removed and queued next.
Очередь скачивания переживает перезапуск: The download queue survives restarts. Downloads can be canceled, and stalled processes time out. New files are linked to track IDs.
Медиатека объединяет данные из старой па: The library imports data from the old folder. Local audio imports are checked for a readable audio stream. Moved files can be relinked from Downloads.
Настройка перемотки по клику применяется: Click-to-seek applies in both lyrics views. Refreshing lyrics preserves attached files. Firefox sign-in import is started from Settings.
«Главная» открывается с поиском сверху и: Home shows search at the top and YouTube Music recommendations below. After listening, refresh recommendations based on your latest track.
Кнопка загрузок внизу слева показывает п: The download button at the bottom left shows progress. Downloads lists the active track, queue, percentage, speed and downloaded tracks. Errors are kept in a separate download log.
Плеер и загрузчик делают до двух повторо: Playback and downloads retry up to twice after an error, then skip to the next track. The last download attempt may save audio without artwork.
Общий сдвиг текста задаётся в настройках: Set a default lyrics offset in Settings. Each track's adjustment is added and remembered. Highlighting is more compact. The pet can look at the active lyrics line and use diagonal head poses from a 36-column sprite sheet.
The pet stays on its platform in play mode. If its platform disappears, it falls gently, then runs and climbs back to the previous platform or the nearest surface. Falling stays smooth when the window loses focus. Switching between artwork and lyrics preserves the pet's platform. Add a tenth PNG row for custom falling frames. A red sidebar notice identifies missing animations.
В Wayland отключена блокирующая вертикал: Blocking vertical sync is disabled on Wayland. Ambient lighting uses a cached texture, unnecessary progress-wave frames are removed, and local artwork extraction is limited to two background jobs.
Значок громкости в большом плеере выровн: The volume icon in the expanded player matches the size of nearby buttons.
Discord Rich Presence использует имя и з: Discord Rich Presence uses Cibitube's name and icon with a built-in application ID. Activity updates during playback, including restored tracks. Connection status appears in Settings.
Сделай или дополни лист кадров питомца д:
Create or extend a Cibitube pet sprite sheet. If I attach a PNG, keep the same character, style, proportions, cell size and foot anchor. Use a transparent PNG with ten rows and 36 columns. For a new character, use 96×96 cells (3456×960 total). If I attach a 36-column sheet with nine rows, keep it and add only the tenth row.

Each row contains nine groups of four frames. Group order: right, down-right, down, down-left, left, up-left, up, up-right, front. A legacy 16-column sheet has left, right, up and down groups. Keep these four groups in their corresponding positions and draw separate frames for all four diagonals and a forward gaze. Turn the head and eyes while preserving body position and proportions.

Row order: appearing, standing, sitting, climbing onto a button, offline, singing while standing, running, disappearing, singing while sitting, falling. In row ten, draw four falling frames for every direction: losing support, tucking the legs, extending the arms for balance, and preparing to land. Keep the character inside its cell. The application moves it downward. The final sitting frame must be a stationary pose. Seated singing changes only the mouth relative to the final sitting frame in the same direction. Keep any existing seated-singing frames. Return the finished PNG without grid lines or labels.
